mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM s_employee e JOIN s_employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.id JOIN s_venue_role r ON r.id = er.role_id AND r.venue_id = e.venue_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_venue_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id WHERE e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.venue_id = #{venueId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.permission_code
